body:
@timkelty no problem. Each pain / roadblock is something that we deeply care about. I'm happy to continue the discussion.

If the information is available to the transformData function for the header, it'll be also available to the templates. I understand that ultimately it feels a lot of work and copying the inner mechanics of InstantSearch.js is not something that we want to promote either. But on the other hand it feels counterproductive to only add a single new piece of information.

What we had in mind when doing the connectors is that making a new widget should be simple enough because you, as a developper / InstantSearch.js user, you wouldn't need to handle the intricacies of managing customisation parameters.

Can you share with us the code that you had to implement, so we could see if we could have done it in a simpler way?
